finish_summary: bulk_discount_percent returns 5% for quantity 50 (should be 10%). parse_coupon rejects case‑insensitive and whitespace‑trimmed codes (e.g., "save5", "  SaVe20 ") that the spec allows. Cart.remove_item leaves a key with value 0 instead of removing it when quantity hits zero. Cart.total accepts an invalid coupon string without raising ValueError, contrary to the spec.
